ItemID: NA; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its electronic, atmospheric direction is less appealing than the heavier rock I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Marshall Mathers       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven rock and metal rather than hip-hop this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Strings Attached; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Polished pop does not fit my current interest in heavier riffs and intense vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: X&Y; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic rock feels too gentle for my current mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: American Idiot Import       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its energetic guitars and punk hooks appeal to the side of my taste reflected in Chuck.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Young and the Hopeless; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Catchy, guitar-driven pop-punk fits my interest in accessible rock alongside the heavier albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Psychedelic rock is less compelling right now than the modern hard rock and metal I have been playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently played 10.000 Days, I would choose another Tool album for its heavy riffs and intricate rhythms.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes Tool's layered, progressive metal especially appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: How to Dismantle An Atomic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its anthemic rock has some appeal, but I would pass this time in favor of the heavier Tool albums.
